title: Cybersecurity Basics
text: Cybersecurity involves protecting computer systems, networks, and data from unauthorized access, damage, or theft. Core practices include using strong, unique passwords and multi-factor authentication, keeping software updated to patch vulnerabilities, encrypting sensitive data, and being cautious of phishing attempts (fraudulent messages designed to trick users into revealing information). Common threats include malware, ransomware, and denial-of-service attacks.
